RewardDesignIR.core_outcome: Imitate discovery window-retained regional feature patterns while preserving native construction; independently test molecular quality and model affinity.

function_lineage.basis: MolThinker/MolExecutor live endpoint pullback and G01 geometric penalty family; correlation-aware kernel representatives are an explicit adaptation.
not_used: S02 population resampling as a coordinate force
operator_components: normalized regional softmin with detached NOS mask

RewardDesignIR.mode_interpretation: Each mixture component is a batch-level retained-feature representative, not a learned biological mode or guaranteed distinct 3D pose. Means may erase within-batch multimodality; two distances cannot uniquely identify a structure.

observables.atom_subset: active predicted N/O/S ligand slots; current predicted categorical mask detached during differentiation
observables.formula: z_r(y)=-tau*log(mean_{i in active NOS,j in fixed region r} exp(-||y_i-q_j||/tau))
observables.frame: the fixed aligned CK2 receptor frame used by discovery features
observables.missing_policy: If no eligible N/O/S ligand slot, mark the particle unavailable and skip reward/injection. Do not substitute a numerical zero or interpret unavailable as a satisfied objective.
observables.normalization: The mean is over all eligible atom-region pairs; this is not nearest distance.

audit_required: retain all 51 raw event means and availability counts
retain copy weights and source batch identifiers
retain background covariance before and after regularization
retained_target_origin.between_batch_weights: Uniform over eligible discovery batches; never weight a batch by offspring counts, candidate count or root popularity.
retained_target_origin.label: ancestors of candidates present immediately after the last observed selection at t=.5; never t=1 success
retained_target_origin.prototype_status: frozen discovery packet independently hashed and interpolation residual reproduced
retained_target_origin.target_formula: mu_b(t_k)=sum_i a_bi(t_k)*z_bi(t_k)/sum_i a_bi(t_k), restricted to jointly available features.
retained_target_origin.within_batch_weights: Normalize recorded window-end descendant-copy counts among jointly finite retained candidates at the same event. Copy weights describe the conditional retained population; they do not increase independent sample size.

scale_origin.covariance_at_unobserved_t: Convex interpolation of adjacent regularized covariance matrices; SPD is preserved. Never elementwise PCHIP a covariance matrix.
scale_origin.do_not_pool: Do not pool raw coordinates/features across all times; mean drift is not instantaneous noise. Do not estimate scale from descendant clone counts.
scale_origin.formula: At each observed t_k, compute joint within-batch covariance from valid matched unguided candidates, then average those covariances equally across eligible discovery batches.
scale_origin.parameter_status: predeclared pilot stabilization, not an inferred optimal bandwidth
scale_origin.regularized_covariance: Symmetrize S_k, eigendecompose, replace eigenvalues below 0.01 A^2, and reconstruct.

selected_reward.boundedness: Pseudo-Huber bounds whitened feature slope. R itself is unbounded below, and live-coordinate gradients can be amplified by the generator Jacobian. External displacement constraints remain necessary.
selected_reward.live_pullback: y=s*h_theta(x,t; detached previous self-conditioning)+COM; g_x=J_y(x,t)^T*grad_y R. Model parameters and previous steps are frozen/detached; current coordinates remain live.
selected_reward.mixture_caveat: At overlapping modes, responsibilities can average opposing directions; symmetry can yield a true zero gradient. Do not force motion after satisfaction or cancellation.
selected_reward.name: uniform-batch correlated radial pseudo-Huber mixture
selected_reward.observable_gradient: With the categorical mask fixed, grad_{y_i} z_r=sum_j p_ij*(y_i-q_j)/||y_i-q_j||, with p_ij normalized across all eligible pairs; guard exact coincidence numerically and record nonfinite outcomes.
selected_reward.shape_parameter_origin: Dimensionless pilot conventions in background-whitened coordinates; not fitted from heldout or affinity.
selected_reward.stable_evaluation: Use log-sum-exp; do not directly exponentiate very negative scores.
selected_reward.weight_separation: w is an internal objective coefficient; external native-relative injection eta is separate. Sum per-particle rewards, never batch-mean gradients.

architecture_comparison.reason: Discard cross-residue correlation, double-count the overlapping patch, and may accept unsupported combinations of the two distances.

architecture_comparison.decision: retain as possible diagnostic, not primary
architecture_comparison.reason: Mahalanobis scaling is appropriate, but a single pooled mean can erase between-batch retained-feature alternatives.
Keeps one joint objective and multiple batch representatives without counting clone abundance as independent evidence; log-mixture is numerically stable in the far field.
Bounded values can introduce far-field vanishing gradients; normalization may then amplify numerical noise. It is not needed because external displacement is explicitly bounded.

Better preserves genuine within-batch alternatives if present, but substantially increases target count and dependence; first quantify retained spread and whether batch means are adequate. Do not call means full distribution preservation.
Polynomial turning points can be fitting artifacts and do not define mechanistic stages.

control_constraints.backtracking: Per particle, halve correction until finite values and all caps/pair/clash guards pass; if the declared finite backtracking limit is reached, use the native proposal and log rejection. Do not reject a whole batch because one particle fails.
control_constraints.budget_accounting: Accumulate RMS of accepted additive corrections per molecule. Use remaining budget and atom cap through one per-molecule scalar; count actual accepted corrections after backtracking.
control_constraints.budget_caveat: With 100 steps and a .025 A maximum atom correction, 2.5 A is a worst-case additive path-length bound and usually adds little beyond the step cap. It does not bound final native trajectory deviation, which the flow can amplify.
control_constraints.clash_predicate: No new severe receptor atom pair: C(corrected) minus C(native) must be empty. A count-only check that trades one removed clash for a different new clash is insufficient.
control_constraints.constraint_scope: These are geometric engineering guards, not physical energy minimization or guarantees of final chemistry.
control_constraints.dt_note: The reference native step already reflects the actual dt and stochastic increment; do not multiply by dt again after RMS normalization unless the runtime defines and documents an equivalent convention.
control_constraints.formula: Let u be the native step displacement in world A on editable active atoms and g the masked current-coordinate gradient converted to the same world-coordinate basis. If available, finite and above the declared numerical gradient floor, delta_raw=eta*RMS(u)*g/RMS(g). Otherwise skip and record the reason. RMS(u)=0 also gives no correction.
control_constraints.gradient_floor: The reviewed runtime skips normalization when RMS of the masked native-coordinate gradient is <=1e-8. This is a numerical pilot constant, not a learned target; gradient-zero/missing cases must remain explicit.
control_constraints.guard_reference: Compare each candidate corrected current state to the same uncorrected native proposal, in the same world frame, with a declared fixed receptor heavy-atom set. Do not compare to the pre-native state.
control_constraints.native_step: Run the unchanged native stochastic/categorical integrator; then add the guided coordinate correction. No particle resampling in gradient arms.
control_constraints.pair_guard_caveat: The .05 A pair-distance limit is already implied by the .025 A per-atom correction cap through the triangle inequality. It is an explicit consistency check, not an independent stronger restriction.
control_constraints.pair_predicate: Maximum absolute change of editable active ligand pair distances relative to native proposal must be <=.05 A. Inactive/fixed atoms remain unchanged.

control_constraints.strength_origin: predeclared exploratory native-RMS ratios, not calibrated biological parameters

evidence_and_counterevidence.consequence: Use typed regional geometry rather than uniformly attracting every atom.
evidence_and_counterevidence.finding: ASN117 endpoint NOS distance has negative integrated expected shift about -0.00852115 A; all-atom distance has positive mean about +0.00100001 A.

evidence_and_counterevidence.consequence: A supported-distribution neighborhood is more defensible than monotone unlimited attraction. Tail thresholds are time-matched background definitions, not physical cutoffs.
evidence_and_counterevidence.finding: Both lower and upper background-defined tails lose expected mass for each primary feature.

evidence_and_counterevidence.consequence: Retained mixture targets are an explicit pilot imitation hypothesis; do not call them a statistically proven optimal distribution.
evidence_and_counterevidence.finding: The retrospective ancestor low/high tail effects have q values approximately .39-.65, so they are not corrected evidence of a sharply preferred retained band.

evidence_and_counterevidence.consequence: No causal local coordinate advantage is established.
evidence_and_counterevidence.finding: Both NOS features show virtually zero same-parent endpoint differences; single-event copy noise is retained.

evidence_and_counterevidence.consequence: Uniform batch weights and independent batch-level evaluation are essential; 14 representatives are not 14 broadly sampled evolution mechanisms.
evidence_and_counterevidence.finding: Mean roots per batch fall from 50 to about 1.214 by .5 while selection ESS remains about 48.43.

evidence_and_counterevidence.consequence: Interpolate raw empirical event representatives locally; do not extrapolate the fitted global polynomial.
evidence_and_counterevidence.finding: Global high-degree curves can reverse observed later signs despite good overall R2.

independent_evaluation.constant_definition: Use mu_b(.5), Sigma(.5) and the same mixture for all t in [0,1).
independent_evaluation.distribution_warning: Matching two feature coordinates is not full pose or molecular-distribution recovery. Report 2D similarity separately from 3D diversity and chemistry.
independent_evaluation.dose_warning: window_only and full have different possible cumulative guidance dose; report accepted additive path length and active steps before attributing differences to late-stage timing.
independent_evaluation.full_definition: Use the same continuous schedule through .5 and frozen terminal reference afterward, with the core objective present throughout.
independent_evaluation.interpretation: Local fit, retained-feature similarity, validity/diversity and affinity can disagree. No single proxy defines overall success.
outcome_layers: joint retained-feature distribution distance and per-batch/mode coverage
actual guidance activity and imposed dose over the entire horizon
final validity/connectivity, unique structures and severe clashes
independent model CK2 affinity rescore; CLK3 only as a diagnostic unless separately targeted
independent_evaluation.pairing: Same checkpoint, 100-step integration scheme, native settings, initial samples and per-batch seeds. Record every RNG difference; no resampling in gradient arms. A historical SMC arm may be reported separately but is not required to define these ablations.
independent_evaluation.statistics: Independent batches are replicates. Report paired effect sizes and uncertainty; do not use atom/node counts as sample size.
independent_evaluation.window_only_definition: Use the full continuous empirical schedule through t=.5, then zero external injection; retain this as an explicit ablation only.

persistent_stage_policy.adaptive_knots: Fit each representative component with PCHIP on a shared time-knot set. At all 51 original times evaluate the maximum over valid batches of ||Sigma(t_k)^(-1/2)*(mu_b,raw(t_k)-mu_b,PCHIP(t_k))||. Add the earliest maximally violating observed time and repeat.
persistent_stage_policy.continuation: For .5<t<1, freeze mu_b(t)=mu_b(.5) and Sigma(t)=Sigma(.5); evaluate the same core term at every native integration step.
persistent_stage_policy.continuation_status: explicit terminal-reference maintenance hypothesis, unsupported by selection evidence after .5
persistent_stage_policy.continuity: Coordinate target and reward are continuous at .5; the external time derivative may have a kink and is not used as a spatial gradient.

frozen_interpolation_audit.meaning: Discovery interpolation only, not validation performance or causal path recovery

persistent_stage_policy.knots_origin: predeclared interpolation-error criterion, not arbitrary .1 bins or inferred biological phase boundaries
persistent_stage_policy.missing_modes: Do not interpolate over unrecorded/undefined NOS targets or silently create a zero target. Prototype extraction must declare complete-window eligible modes and all excluded batch/times. Insufficient coverage prevents freezing that configuration.
persistent_stage_policy.objective_persistence: Each interpolation segment uses the same correlated regional objective. No early term is silently removed when a later segment becomes active.
persistent_stage_policy.termination: Stop when all jointly supported original events meet tolerance; at worst retain all 51 events. Store residuals, knots and raw values; inspect between-node behavior because a node-wise tolerance is not a continuous supremum bound.

calibration_metrics: achieved versus requested RMS ratio conditional on valid nonzero-gradient steps
pilot_calibration_rule.decision: Run and report all three ratios. Freeze one external ratio before comparison based only on numerical feasibility and realized control, never final affinity or discovery-fit improvement. Preserve all calibration outputs; no silent retuning of prototypes.

recommended_engineering_selection_rule.pilot_interpretation: n=12 per arm is a feasibility screen, not a significance test or efficacy study; final quality gates are distinct from per-step native-proposal guards.
recommended_engineering_selection_rule.rationale: Avoid choosing a nominally strong setting whose actual control is dominated by clipping or rejection. These thresholds are engineering conventions and must be predeclared if used.
recommended_engineering_selection_rule.rule: Among ratios passing mandatory checks with zero accepted guard violations, retain the largest with median(applied/desired RMS)>=.5 over eligible nonzero desired steps, complete rejection fraction<=.05, valid-molecule count no more than one below matched unguided, and final severe-clash count no greater than matched unguided. If none qualifies, report calibration failure. Do not rank by affinity.

factors: Earlier core guidance was disabled after its short early support instead of evaluating the objective over the full horizon.
A one-sided median stop intentionally supplies zero force below the stopping value and did not model both depleted tails.
Independent scalar targets omitted joint patch correlation and between-batch alternatives.
A raw scalar gradient strength did not report its size relative to native-step motion.
These structural limitations do not prove why any specific experimental run succeeded or failed.
